lines.text: Red name. Sit at the back. The Row's neutral; that's a thing I arrange, not a thing that happens.
Everyone's a faction enemy in here, sweetheart. That's why the drinks are expensive.
Sweetheart. You've got the card. Sit. First one's on Vantongeren; she pays me to say that.
Sweetheart. Sit. A thing on the tablet, a price on the card. You can look before you choose.
Good. That's a thing done. You'll find there are more.
Vantongeren's card. She sends me the ones she thinks will last. Don't make her wrong.
There's a record now, sweetheart. Read it before you pay anyone to explain it. Charge them for the chair.
Sweetheart. Sit. A thing on the tablet, a price on the card. You can look before you choose.

barks.text: The ring above us lit the whole Row once. Now it lights me. I take that personally.
